method: 16 male core voices -> round 1 (ICC cricket climax, English source -> hi/ta/te) -> top 5 -> round 2 (Spanish radio goal call -> hi/ml/gu; Peter Drury English -> ta/te/kn). 27 finalist runs through the production relay. Scored on log-mel + pitch features (F0 range, presence 2-5 kHz, spectral flux, loudness dynamics, excitement tracking vs source pitch), pacing, script fidelity, synthesized-roar share, and a gemini-3.8-flash listening judge.
why: Most consistent excitement across sports, source languages and 9 Indic targets (judge 9-10 on the Spanish goal call in hi/ml/gu); wide pitch excursions with curved, moving harmonics rather than flat holds; male register; near-zero synthesized crowd noise; pacing close to the source.
